project.admin_access_granted.description: The existing administrative screen received successful server authorization; once per account entry, excluding denied access and repeated permission refreshes.

project.email_confirmed.description: A signup confirmation-link return produced an authenticated session with a confirmed email; does not count confirmations outside the app.

project.login_completed.description: A successful new sign-in session transition, including social login; excludes initial restored sessions, token refreshes, signup confirmation and password recovery.

project.signup_completed.description: A new email/password registration succeeded; obfuscated existing-address responses are excluded.
